business_goal: A video cached once (HLS or mp4) is served from cache on every later request even after the CDN re-signs its URL, and a malformed URL never crashes — CacheKeyPolicy.keyFor/filePathFor replace the full-href and pathname-only key derivations at all 7 real call sites (R0/R1, A1, UC-NormalizeCacheKey, breadboard slice V1).
